mobbin:3c069b65-da04-47ec-a852-5165ac635.summary: User picks Voice note, records with a live transcript overlay and large Stop control, pauses through Saving…, then reviews Transcript and Summary tabs before the note appears on Home.
steps: Home — recent Untitled voice note card
Paused — Saving voice note… toast + Summary spinner
Paused My notes — iPhone Microphone + Resume
Summary tab — bulleted AI summary + Resume
Home — voice note card with transcript preview
steal: Large white Stop / Resume on the floating bar (steps 3–5) — big-target record control for one-hand use.
Live transcript overlay while still on My notes (step 4) — confirm capture without leaving the note.
My notes / Transcript / Summary tabs (steps 5–9) — separate freeform notes from STT and skim summary.
iPhone Microphone source pill (steps 5–8) — explicit audio-input label (not a processing-locale label).
avoid: No on-device vs cloud transcription indicator and no per-line timestamps on Transcript (steps 6–7) — only scrubber time; weak for GDPR-sensitive or moment-linked faculty notes.
mobbin:3c069b65-da04-47ec-a852-5165ac635.fit: Mobile wins for dictating a note at the bedside of a live session; extends Baseline voice-notes, but Essentials needs on-device STT labeling and timestamp anchors Otter-style — Fabric does not show those.

mobbin:c10feffc-9e32-4467-914a-72668daa0.summary: From a paused video the user opens draw tools, marks a person with a freehand circle, saves the drawing, then sees it as a timestamped Drawing entry in Comments.
steps: Video player — pencil / comment / hide / settings
Draw mode — tool rail + Cancel / Save drawing
Markup — blue circle on subject + Save drawing
Saved — drawing on frame + avatar on scrubber + Comments 1
Comments — Drawing · 00:00:00 badge + Timestamp chip on compose
steal: Cancel vs Save drawing decision on the frame (steps 2–4) — discard without leaving the player.
Hide-annotations eye toggle beside pencil (steps 1, 5) — clean playback vs markup view.
Drawing · 00:00:00 type+time badge in the comment list (step 6) — annotation kind visible at a glance.
Timestamp chip on the compose field (step 6) — next text reply stays anchored to the same moment.
avoid: Vertical tool rail icons stay relatively small on the frame (steps 2–4) — risky for gloved faculty; enlarge primary pen/save.
mobbin:c10feffc-9e32-4467-914a-72668daa0.fit: Mobile is strong for private frame markup during debrief walk-around; extends Baseline debrief-annotations — keep big-screen control on web/SRV, phone/tablet for personal draws.

mobbin:65f315e4-072d-473a-8c75-05053aba2.summary: In a note with two unchecked items the user taps the second checkbox and it becomes a filled check with strikethrough text before Save.
steps: Note — two unchecked checklist rows + Save
Note — second item checked + strikethrough + Save
steal: Checked state = filled box + strikethrough text (step 2) — redundant completion cue at a glance.
avoid: Standard small checkbox hit targets (steps 1–2) — fail gloved/one-hand live-event checklist use.
mobbin:65f315e4-072d-473a-8c75-05053aba2.fit: Does not beat desktop for live sim rubrics; weak counter to Baseline checklist — keep big toggles / partial credit / auto-timestamp elsewhere.
